reviews.title: Quality case, competitive price, but buy a modular or semi modular PSU for your build.
reviews.comment: well built case - full size atx board fit comfortably. Not to plentiful for hard drives, but space for one in a bracket for a 3.5 and two 2.5, though I had to tweak for a third. PSU fit fine, screws are well fitting and well made. Documentation is rather sparce, but this was my first build, really kind of forgiving. Follow the directions of the motherboard. Fans work fine and cooling is no issue for me, rather really overkill for my needs. Nice glass side panel to see your setup working away, good for RGB lighting if you have any, but this case was without the RGB lighting. I don't care to have my room light up like a disco. ANyway that's me. For the quality I thought it was really a good deal. competitive price. Cable management wasn't too bad, but in the end I wish I would have bought a modular or a semi modular PSU instead of the basic one I bought, have some extra cables that are just taking up space, had to wrap some with quick ties. Thanks.
reviews.author: Justin Huber
